summary: Coldwood and EA's Unravel games are yarn-based physics puzzle-platformers, with the first entry focused on a single-player journey through natural environments and memory vignettes.

entries.title: Unravel

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with settings/input state documented

primary.why: The PC release is the best capture route for Unravel's physics puzzles and visual presentation, while console versions are equivalent access routes. Current PC availability through Steam/EA app makes it the practical archive path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/EA app state, build, graphics settings, controller/keyboard input, level, collectible/secret state, difficulty/accessibility assumptions, and whether console versions or Unravel Two were excluded.

secondary.why: PC remains the cleanest capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original single-player physics puzzle-platform route, with PC preferred for capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive story content is required; PC is the preferred capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Unravel Two; record EA app/login state.
